feature: EDS ordered RPC drop categories and dynamic admission

behavior.sampling: independent uniform sample in [0,1000000) for each category in received order; first match rejects; strict threshold and zero/full fractions are preserved
behavior.ownership: ordinary/shared Channels own validated category storage, 256 entries and 4096 UTF8 bytes per name; empty categories allocate/sample nothing
behavior.unary: local UNAVAILABLE response has transport=null, was_dropped=true and owned EDS-configured drop reason; retry stops before throttle debit or replay
behavior.hedging_streams: marked drop is a fatal hedge winner; pending hedges stop and losers cancel; streaming/duplex open returns CallDropped before application HEADERS
behavior.dynamic_policy: EDS publication updates categories in same transaction as topology; explicit SharedChannel updates support keep/replace/disable with allocation rollback
behavior.queued_active: queued physical requests reevaluate once on actual policy-content revision; identical updates and owner wakes do not resample; active calls finish
behavior.drop_all: full drop reports READY from init/publication even with no endpoints; shutdown still reports SHUTDOWN
behavior.validation: invalid metadata/message size, expired admission and canceled queue calls do not consume drop samples; dropped responses do not debit retry throttle
behavior.telemetry: monotonic evaluated/dropped counters persist across policy updates
behavior.internal_transport: subchannel protocol owners and health/control channels do not inherit application drop categories
behavior.outlier_validation: socket outlier test now establishes explicit sample/ejection/expiry phases so scheduler delay cannot invalidate volume expectations; actual backend selection and timer recovery remain checked
